claim: In 2024 the cooperative collected 4,850 tonnes of parchment coffee.
Coffee collection increased in 2024 compared with 2023.
The 2024 collection fell by 6% because of the rains.
Close to 5,000 tonnes of coffee were collected in 2024.
90% of the collected coffee has organic certification.
The cooperative has 2,300 members.
The majority of the members are women.
Exports totaled USD 19.2 million in 2024.
Germany was the main export destination.
The cooperative sold coffee to the United States in 2024.
The Villa Rica drying plant started to operate in October 2024.
The Villa Rica drying plant started to operate in 2023.
The cooperative installed solar panels at the collection centers.
The cooperative's equity grew 9% in 2024.
The cooperative's equity decreased during the fiscal year.
The auditors identified material observations on cash management.
Rio Alto delivered 40 containers to European roasters in 2024.
Rio Alto delivered 55 containers to European roasters in 2024.
Average cupping scores fell in 2024.
All lots showed moisture above the contractual limit.
The cooperative obtained a loan from Banco Rural del Valle in 2024.
Rio Alto won the national barista championship.
The average price paid to the producer was USD 4 per kilo.
The cooperative exported coffee mainly to Germany, which accounted for 35% of the volume.
